overview: You looked at the ballad and did not take it. The sheet had a woodcut of a ship that has served for three other voyages, and the letters were rubbed down. You left it in the seller's hand.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked, and did not take the sheet.

parties.name: George Bryan
parties.context: Walked up with him. He did not buy it either.

assets.name: the ballad sheet
